label: 土_食神 · catalyst · row 1 · cost_others · chip Gives first (was Hearty)

label: 土_食神 · catalyst · row 2 · cost_self · chip Makes things last (was Settled)

label: 土_食神 · catalyst · row 2 · cost_others · chip Makes things last (was Settled)

label: 木_偏印 · catalyst · row 3 · drive · chip Sleeps on it (was Self-taught)

label: 木_偏印 · friction · row 1 · cost_self · chip Thinks in circles (was Tangled)

label: 木_偏印 · friction · row 1 · cost_others · chip Thinks in circles (was Tangled)

label: 木_偏印 · friction · row 2 · drive · chip Keeps it in (was Secretive)

label: 木_偏印 · friction · row 2 · cost_self · chip Keeps it in (was Secretive)

label: 木_偏印 · friction · row 2 · cost_others · chip Keeps it in (was Secretive)

Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Water keeps it deep, and rules sink in to stay. As a friction, the pull turns inward, so you hold your rank rather than risk it on a crisis and pay in tests never taken.

options.text: Discipline, for you, is imported, so import it well. Sleep on anything irreversible. Keep a reviewer you cannot charm and show them everything big. Put a cool number on every hot plan before saying yes.

You do your best work with a date on it and someone waiting at the other end. Give each big plan a finish line before you start it. Once a month, hand a decision to someone whose call you will keep. Tell one person your deadline. Set a stop time before you begin.

options.text: Prudence past its dose becomes fear with a clipboard. Give small decisions a five-minute timer. Reserve real review for the truly irreversible. Once a month, act on a warm impulse the same day it arrives and audit the result later.

Seek Wood, the Mind energy. Wood is fuel that grows: it drinks the rain and turns it into something a fire can use. Let it hold what Water pours on you. You take every rule to heart faster than you take anything in. Learn one thing a week nobody asked you for. Give each new demand a night to sit.

options.text: Water ends fire, the old texts say: the many overcome the few, and rain outlasts any blaze. Heat climbs and spreads wherever it finds fuel, and water is the one thing it cannot consume. Poured over a flame, water does not argue with it. It takes the heat into itself, rises as steam and leaves the ground cool and dark, and every fire that meets water learns its true size.

The many prevail over the few, and so water commands fire: one flame meets the falling rain, and however bright it burned, the rain does not run out first. What survives learns to burn banked and careful. Rain is the blaze's schooling: after it, fire keeps its heat closer and wastes less light.

options.text: Fire is your Body, and running thin, it is the energy behind your warmth: sociability, drive, the lift that makes mornings possible. Yours runs in bursts, so depletion shows as dimness with people you love.

Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Fire makes it warm, so you recover by doing. Running thin, the reserve goes first, and you go alone ahead of asking a peer or bet bold instead of rest. You pay for each bright day with lost rest.

options.text: Fire is your Body, and running over, it is more heat than your days can spend: sleep that will not come, intensity leaking into every conversation, rest that feels like a punishment.

options.text: Lights answer one another, the old histories say: flame set beside flame makes one blaze, brighter than the sum of what was lit. There is no reaction between them, only reinforcement, heat agreeing with heat. Such doubling warms whole houses, and it can also empty the woodpile twice as fast.

Fire meets fire and neither has to fight the other for air, the old texts say: like lights shine on each other, and like seeks like. One flame set beside another takes nothing from it. Each feeds on what it was given and both grow brighter for the company, until the shared heat outruns what any single hearth can hold. Fire is the one element fed by its own kind and spent by it.

options.text: Difficulty is your natural price filter, so use it openly. Take the assignment everyone else avoids. Price your work higher than feels comfortable and let the discomfort season. Once a year, pick one skill hard enough to embarrass you for months.

Your drive outruns the places you can put it, and an opening only looked at becomes weight. Say yes to one opening and no to the next two out loud. options.text: The refined prevails over the stubborn, and so fire works metal: in the furnace the hardest thing in the world goes soft, gives up its rock, and takes a finer form. Cold, metal refuses every argument. Heated, it flows like consent, and the smith reads the glow the way farmers read the sky.

Fire works metal, the old texts say: the forge softens the blade, and iron that held one shape for ages gives it up inside the heat. The flame does not break the ore, it loosens it until the hammer can ask for a new line. Every fire wants something hard to work on, and every finished blade keeps the warmth that once made it move.
